title: GMind_AI
summary:
GMind AI is an AI-powered educational platform developed by Gotocourse. It is described as an all-in-one, AI-first teaching workspace that streamlines lesson preparation to virtual classrooms with AI precision and teacher-first simplicity. The platform was built for Africa and is scaling across the Global South.

GMind AI is the complete School AI platform, offering an AI workspace, virtual classrooms, smart teaching tools, and data insights, all accessible to every teacher and student. The platform is powered by the school's data and brand identity. It features over 25 AI teaching agents built for real classrooms, from lesson plans to personalized learning paths, designed to help teachers save time, spark engagement, and teach with impact.

The platform provides interactive, 24/7 classrooms with live teaching, assignments, and discussions. It includes AI-driven assessments and analytics that identify learning gaps and create personalized study paths for every student. GMind's offline features and multilingual tools aim to make classrooms more inclusive and effective.

Key features include an AI workspace for educators, tools for lesson planning and curriculum development, virtual classroom capabilities, smart search and AI-powered answer engine for students and educators, and data-driven insights for school administrators. The platform addresses educational challenges in regions with limited resources by providing AI-powered tools that work both online and offline.
